name: B10-0112/2025 (S&D) – Further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the further deterioration of the political situation in Georgia
part_text:
The European Parliament says Georgia's October 2024 election was not free or fair and that the new parliament is not legitimate. It calls for the election to be rerun within a year under international observation. It urges Georgia's government to stop police violence against protesters, release people held arbitrarily, and hold those responsible to account. It also asks the European Union to avoid meetings with Georgian officials until a new election is held, tighten sanctions, and give more money to independent media and civil society groups.

- The EU is asked to suspend some visa arrangements and consider sanctions on Georgian officials and allies.
- Georgian officials, judges, media owners and protesters are directly affected.
- The EU and Georgia's government must respond; a new election is demanded within a year.
